title: The Final Hours Begin
ongoing: Doom rate is now +3 per day.

title: Something Worse Approaches
immediate: Pre-warning. The Source arrives at next Dawn.
art_notes: A swelling shape just beyond the streetlight

title: The Source Arrives
immediate: Place the Source at the center of the map. Doom +3.
ongoing: The Source is the final boss. The team must defeat it before Day 7 ends OR survive Day 7 with Doom < 30.
art_notes: A Burtonesque mass with no clear shape

title: Despair
immediate: Each player rolls Sanity d8: lose Sanity equal to (face value / 2 round up).
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Rest restores no Sanity.
art_notes: Heads in hands at a kitchen table

title: A Way Out
immediate: Any one player may immediately become Down to reduce Doom by 5. (Optional.)

title: The Last Lights Go Out
immediate: All players lose 1 Sanity. All Battery tokens lose 1 charge (if a charge system exists; otherwise discard 1 Battery per player).
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Only Fire is a light source.

title: Hope Remains
immediate: All players gain +1 Sanity. Doom advance is reduced by 1 this Dawn only.

title: The Truth Is Worse Than You Imagined
immediate: If the team has all 3 Clue cards: place a Truth Trophy. Otherwise: all players lose 2 Sanity.
art_notes: Pages of a book burning into glyphs

title: All Together
immediate: Move all standees to the same tile (player vote).
ongoing: Until next Dawn: All players gain +1 Sanity at Tick if at the same tile as another player.
art_notes: Five silhouettes huddled around one chair

title: Dawn Breaks
immediate: Doom does not advance this Dawn.
ongoing: If this is Day 7: continue to the final Tick. Survival check.

title: The Ground Splits Open
immediate: A random location tile is destroyed (removed from the map). Players there must flee to adjacent tiles. Resources there are lost.
art_notes: A suburban street cracking apart with light pouring from below

title: The Last Meal
immediate: All Food at every location is destroyed. Recipes cooked this day restore +2 extra Hunger.
art_notes: An empty pantry with the door hanging off its hinges

title: The Voices Come Back
immediate: Every player rolls Sanity d8. Lose that much Sanity. Players at the same tile as an ally halve the result (round down).
art_notes: Dozens of mouths opening in the sky

title: The Source Offers a Bargain
immediate: Choose one player to negotiate: they roll d6. On 4+: Doom -3. On 1-3: that player goes Down immediately.
art_notes: A tendril of darkness extending a hand with too many joints

title: A Flood of Memories
immediate: Each player gains +2 Sanity. Then each player loses 1 Health. (The memories are sharp.)
ongoing: Until next Dawn: players at their own home gain +2 Sanity at sleep instead of +1.
art_notes: A wave of polaroids and journal pages washing down a hallway
